STEP 3 - Items: (a) salmon fillet pieces (three visible), (b) sliced carrots, (c) roasted yellow/orange vegetable wedge, (d) diced pineapple, (e) small green herb/pepper bits and a little dark vegetable (peppers/greens) underneath.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 390 g with roughly 475 kcal is plausible for a fish fillet portion with vegetables and fruit covering about 60% of a dinner plate. The salmon dominates the energy, which fits the visible portion size.
